note: The geometry gate's AppShell harness page (scripts/geometry-gate/harness), rendered as the opt-in phone title's before and after (frontend#208). `titled` passes `pageTitle` to AppShell; `hidden` is the same page with `PageHeader hideOnPhone` and no `pageTitle`, the shape that left seven audited screens with no title on a phone. Build it with `GATE_OUT=~/.cache/primitives-usage/dist/layout-demo npx vite build -c scripts/geometry-gate/harness/vite.config.mjs`.

screens.name: hidden
screens.why: Before: AppShell without `pageTitle` over a page whose PageHeader is `hideOnPhone`. The phone header shows the app name alone.

screens.name: titled
screens.why: After: AppShell with `pageTitle`. The phone header shows the page title as the h1 and the app name sits in the switcher.
